title: Incorrect Grapher local-update instruction exposed installer mismatch

content.failure: The implementation agent instructed the user to run `./install.sh --local` for Grapher after the inline-menu fix. Unlike Dreadnought's installer, Grapher's install.sh did not implement --local and silently ignored the argument while installing the latest published release.
content.impact: The user reinstalled an older published Grapher build and continued to receive the retired full-screen menu, making the merged inline-menu fix appear ineffective.
content.root_cause: The agent assumed installer feature parity between Grapher and Dreadnought without inspecting Grapher's install.sh before giving update instructions. Grapher's script also failed to reject unknown arguments, allowing the incorrect command to appear successful.
content.detection: User reported that Grapher still opened the old full-screen menu after following the local-update instructions.
content.remediation: PR #30 adds an actual --local mode, rejects unexpected arguments, installs the checked-out source tree in local mode, updates installation documentation, and adds regression coverage for installer semantics.
content.prevention: Cross-repository operational instructions must be verified against each repository's current executable/install scripts rather than inferred from another repository. Installers should fail closed on unsupported arguments and CI should test documented local-install modes.
